input: Summarize the average delivery time for customers in 'Rio de Janero' for orders with a 'shippd' status.
expected_output: No data was found for orders with a 'shipped' status and customers in 'Rio de Janeiro'.
name: FZY-05

additional_metadata.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT AVG(o.actual_delivery_time_days) AS average_delivery_time_days
FROM fct_orders o
JOIN dim_customers c ON o.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
WHERE EDITDISTANCE(LOWER(o.order_status), LOWER('shipped')) <= 2
AND EDITDISTANCE(LOWER(c.customer_city), LOWER('Rio de Janeiro')) <= 2
GROUP BY c.customer_city
ORDER BY average_delivery_time_days;
